Initiation orders are the orders by which people progress through [[alo]].<ref name=":0" />

The main ones are as follows<ref name=":0" />

* [[Ola]]
* [[Alo (initiation order)|Alo]]
* [[Olalo]]{{Efn|Not mentioned in original article}}
* [[Lambda First]]

== Aol and Oal ==
Aol and Oal are minor initiation orders normally associated with neopaganism. They come from a rejection of organized religion and a resistance to the [[Lambda]]. Neither is particularly notable as they do not lead to [[faustery]] as [[Lambda First]] and [[Alo (initiation order)|Untrained Alo]] tend to do, but they usually lead to an ineffectual spiritual growth.
